# FitHub
> AI-powered fitness tracking, intelligent routine generation, and exercise biomechanics platform.

FitHub provides fitness tracking, science-backed workout routine generation via FitHub AI, a 1,300+ animated exercise database with GIF demonstrations, an interactive 2D muscle anatomy map, and healthy macro-balanced nutrition recipes.

## Key Features & Public Endpoints

- **Home & Feature Hub**: `https://fit-hubb.netlify.app/`
  - Overview of AI workout generator, feature highlights, and body part filters.
- **Exercise Library (1,300+ Exercises)**: `https://fit-hubb.netlify.app/exercises`
  - Searchable exercise repository filterable by target muscle, body part, and gym equipment with step-by-step form execution.
- **2D Muscle Anatomy Map & Biomechanics Explorer**: `https://fit-hubb.netlify.app/anatomy`
  - Interactive anatomical front/back muscle map showing prime mover exercises, optimal set/rep schemes, and dynamic warmup protocols.
- **Nutritious Recipes Feed**: `https://fit-hubb.netlify.app/recipes`
  - High-protein, Low-carb, Keto, and Vegan meal guides with exact calorie and macronutrient breakdowns.
- **Fitness Calculators & Tools**: `https://fit-hubb.netlify.app/fitnesstools`
  - Olympic barbell plate calculator, One-Rep Max (1RM) estimator, and Body Mass Index (BMI) calculator.

## Technical Overview

- **Frontend**: React SPA, Redux Toolkit, Vanilla SCSS design system, Service Worker offline caching.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB with weighted compound text indexes, JWT with HttpOnly cookies.
- **AI Integrations**: FitHub Neural AI Engine with structured JSON schema for personalized workout generation and biomechanical motor unit analysis.
